landmarks.note: Where the Whitehorn Range gives way to the Amethyst Barrens: votary road furniture, a march stone, a waystation, and 16 pieces of the country beyond.

landmarks.label: The Snowline Stones
landmarks.name: The Snowline Stones
landmarks.note: Ten cut stones up the slope, each with a brass line where the snow stood the year it was set. The last three stand above the snow now.
